wholeSelectedGoalRows.title: Bau von Auge oder Ohr

wholeSelectedGoalRows.title: Bau des Blutes

wholeSelectedGoalRows.descriptionEn: The learner can name blood components and describe their properties.

wholeSelectedGoalRows.title: Mitose und Meiose
